claims.claim: Cylindrical tools and CSG subtraction define geometric material removal; target-aware occupancy/shape-preservation losses constrain reconstruction. Force, temperature, tool wear and fixture physics are not demonstrated in the reviewed model.
Tool-radius options in normalized shape space; paper softmax weighted selection, two-layer256LSTM,64-cubed occupancy and20-step caps. Normalized numbers are not calibrated millimetre tolerances.
ABC sample50testshapes; ShapeNet130 from13categories. Whole dataset sizes are not independent validation samples.
100 pretraining epochs and12,000 per-object fine-tuning iterations (~30min) reported; zero-shot means training per individualshape, not instant inference.
Reconstruction metrics IoU/F1 at256-cubed andCD/NCfrom8k surfacepoints; CDreportedscaled1000. ABCIoU.824 does not qualify an actual CNC profile.
ABC surfaceCD.509 vsCAPRI.312; NC.893 vs.914; volume improvement coexists with surface trade-off.
ShapeNetTable2 printsF1down-arrow but discussion and other tables treat largerF1asbetter; retain as visible inconsistency, not reverse metric orientation.
Zero-shotABC IoU.780 vsfine-tuned.824; ShapeNet.698vs.740; CDalsochanges. These are descriptive rounded-table differences, not significance tests.
Paper states no reference dataset of operation sequences to assess efficiency/optimality; broader tool/operation/stock support remains futurework.
Simulation/reconstruction of CAD stock and paths is a manufacturing proxy. Independent machine metrology and field-production evidence are not established in reviewed main pages.
Modelisconstructedafresh; existingcheckpointisloadedonlyifcontinue_fromnotNone. Defaultquickstartisoptimizationratherthanpretrainedinference.
